title: Towards Systematics of Calabi-Yau Landscape for String Cosmology
summary: In this review, we discuss the relevance and impact of studying Calabi-Yau threefolds in the context of global model building in string phenomenology. First, taking a phenomenologist-friendly approach, we review how the topologies of the various divisors and curves of the compactifying CY threefolds play a crucial role for generating the various ``suitable" classes of effective scalar potentials, within the framework of the popular moduli stabilization schemes such as KKLT and LVS.
